text:
viv: FYI heavy drizzle + flash puddles on 3rd St this AM, I hit a wave from a passing truck and my shoes are now 80% soggy. Anyone else seeing splash zones on 101/280?

ash: 280 southbound looked ok from my end but got slowed by a fender-bender before the Hillsdale exit. Took an extra 20m. :umbrella:

omar: @viv ouch. I pinged the office Slack about spare towels but figured I'd ask here first. Also Muni's bus tracker is showing clustering on 3rd/King.

li: Took Caltrain and they were running a bit late (6-9m) but way less wet than street-level options. If you're near the peninsula it's a reasonable hedge.

sara: quick office update: there's a communal umbrella bag by reception (navy duffel) and a stack of nitrile gloves in the pantry for wet shoe rescue. Please label anything you take. :memo:

viv: bless you sara. I left a Post-it that says "for soggy souls".

commute-bot: Morning snapshot: I-280 S heavy traffic near 4th Ave (15-25 min delay). Caltrain: minor delay for southbound 9:12. Muni: delays on 3rd/King corridor.

ash: anyone tried biking this morning? I'm considering it but worried about traction on the wet paint lines.

li: I rode in — slower cadence, wider turns, lights on. Tanked the commute time by only ~5m compared to the stalled cars; depends on route. Bring fenders if you have them.

omar: Poll: what's your rescue plan if shoes get soaked? react: :tshirt: dry at desk, :sneaker: change shoes, :bus: take transit and hope for dry spells, :umbrella: borrow from office

sara: :umbrella: (borrow)

viv: :sneaker: changing into clogs under my desk after lunch.

ash: Thanks for the heads-up on the duffel @sara. If anyone leaves a spare pair in the lobby bin, shout and I'll bring it to Mission on my way.

commute-bot: Reminder: if you're on a Redwood shuttle route, the 5:15 departure from Mission may be delayed up to 10 minutes due to traffic near 7th/Market.

li: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/rain-splash-3o6Zt6ML6BklcajjsA (mood)

viv: Alright team, staying flexible today. If anyone needs a quick umbrella drop in SoMa, DM me and I can swing by after 11.
